name: grand-line-duel
description: Grand Line Duel — adaptation web non commerciale de Splendor Duel, habillage pirate.

scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-grand-line-duel "npm run test:emulator -w @gld/functions"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gld/functions && npm run build -w @gld/web
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @gld/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-grand-line-duel
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,functions,hosting
